description: This file defines the DdlReaderError class, which models an error or diagnostic message generated during the reading/parsing of DDL (Document Definition Language) files within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.IO namespace. It provides constructors for creating error instances with detailed source information and overrides ToString for error message formatting.

classes.name: DdlReaderError
classes.description: Represents an error or diagnostic message reported by the DDL reader. Contains details such as error level, message, source location, and error number.

methods.name: DdlReaderError
methods.description: Constructor initializing a DdlReaderError object with specified error level, message, number, and source location details.

methods.name: DdlReaderError
methods.description: Constructor initializing a DdlReaderError object with specified error level, message, number, and source location details.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the error, including source file and position, error number, and message.
